name: decision-guide
title: Three-path decision guide
description: A responsive choice of three service approaches with visible criteria and tradeoffs.

files.content:
FIND YOUR STARTING POINT

Choose the approach that fits your next goal.

Three paths with explicit tradeoffs, not a simulated selector.

Explore

Useful when requirements are still changing and you need to test an idea.

  • Small initial scope
  • Room to learn
Discovery details

Build

Useful when the problem is understood and the workflow is ready to implement.

  • Defined milestones
  • Reviewable deliverables
Build details

Improve

Useful when an existing service needs fewer bottlenecks and clearer feedback.

  • Baseline first
  • Measured iteration
Improvement details
